name: DoF-NeRF
definition: A neural rendering framework that extends NeRF to simulate the aperture of a lens following geometric optics, allowing it to operate on views with different focus configurations and manipulate DoF effects by adjusting virtual aperture and focus parameters.
summary: DoF-NeRF is a neural rendering framework that simulates physical lens depth-of-field effects by jointly optimizing aperture and focus distance parameters to synthesize all-in-focus views from shallow depth-of-field inputs.
